senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (कुमारयति)
To play, especially as a child; also कुमाल.

m. (-रः)
1 A boy, one under five years of age.
2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
3 A prince, the heir apparent, and who is associated to the empire, (in theatrical language.)
4 A horseman, a cavalier.
5 A parrot.
6 One of the attendants on the twenty-four Jinas, and also a sanctified character amongst the Jaina sect.
7 A tree, (Tapia crataeva): see वरुण.
8 A name of the Sindhu river or Indus.
n. (-रं)
Pure gold.
f. (-री)
1 A young girl, one from ten to twelve years old, a virgin; or in the Tantras any virgin to the age of sixteen, or as long as menstruation has not commenced.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
3 The central part of the universe according to Hindu geography, Jambu Dvīpa or India.
4 The most southerly of the nine portions of the known continent, or of Jambu Dvīpa, the southern extremity of the peninsula, whence Cape Comorin or Kumāri.
5 The name of a river flowing from the mountain Sactiman.
6 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea): see अपराजिता.
7 Double jasmin.
8 The aloe tree, (Aloes perfoliata): see घृतकुमारी.
9 The Śyāmā, a bird so named.
E.
कुमार to play as a child, affix अच् fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
1 A boy, a lad.
2 A tree: see वरुण.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-ती)
The slayer of a child.
E.
कुमार, हन to kill, णिनि aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A name of Rājā SĀLIVĀHANA.
2 Name of a king of Guzerat.
E.
कुमार a child, and पाल a cherisher.

f. (-त्या)
Care of a pregnant or lying-in woman, midwifery.
E.
कुमार a child, and भृत्या cherishing.

m. (-युः)
A prince.
E.
कुमार a prince, या to go or be, and उ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ही)
A peacock.
E.
कुमार KĀRTTIKEYA, and वाहिन् what bears; this god being usually represented riding on a peacock.

f. (-सूः)
A name of GAṄGĀ, the river goddess.
E.
कुमार the god KĀRTTIKEYA, and सू a mother.

f. (-का)
1 A girl from ten to twelve years old, or generally a virgin.
2 Double jasmin.
3 A division of the known continent.
4 Large cardamoms.
5 An insect, (Sphex Asiatica): see कुमारी, कन् being added.

r. 10th cl. (कुमालयति)
To play as a child, &c.: see कुमार.

m. (-कः)
The name of a district, part of Malva: also termed Sauvīra.

mfn. (-त् or द्)
1 Niggardly, avaricious.
2 Unkind, unfriendly.
n. (-त् or -द्)
1 The esculent white water lily.
2 The red lotus.
E.
कु the earth, or bad, vile, मुद to be pleased, and क्विप् affix; also कुमुद.

n. (-दं)
1 The white esculent water lily, (Nymphaea esculenta.)
2 The red lotus, (N. rubra.)
3 Silver.
m. (-दः)
1 The elephant of the south-west quarter.
2 One of the monkey heroes of the Rāmāyaṇa.
3 One of the Nāga or serpent race.
4 A Dānava or infernal deity.
5 Camphor.
f. (-दा)
1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
2 A tree, (Gmelina arborea): see गम्भारी.
(-दी)
A medicinal and aromatic shrub, commonly Kāyaphal.
E.
कु the earth, &c. मुद to be pleased, and क aff.

m. (-वः)
The moon.
E.
कुमुद a lotus, and बान्धव the friend; the white esculent lotus expanding its petals during the night, and closing them in the day time; hence other similar appellations of the moon, as कुमुदवन्धु, कुमुदप्रिय, &c.

f. (-ती)
A place abounding in water lilies, &c. see कुमुद्धती.

m. (-रः)
A number of water lilies or place abounding with them.
E.
कुमुद, and आकर a mine; also कुमुदवनं, कुमुदिनी, &c.

m. (-सः)
A pool abounding in lotuses.
E.
कुमुद, and आवास a residence.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Abounding with water lilies.
E.
कुमुद, and ठच् aff.

f. (-का)
A small tree, the seeds of which are aromatic, commonly Kāyaphal: see कुमुदी, and कट्फल.

f. (-नी)
A place abounding in lotuses, &c. see कुमुद्धती.
E.
कुमुद, इनि and ङीष् aff.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
कुमुदिनी, and पति lord: see कुमुदबान्धव.

m. (-शः)
The moon: see कुमुदबान्धव.
E.
कुमुद, and ईश a master.

mfn. (-द्वान्-द्वती-द्वत्)
A place abounding in the flowers of the Nymphaea esculenta.
f. (-ती)
1 The same.
2 A multitude of lotus flowers.
3 The flexible stalk of a water lily.
4 A sort of water lily, (Menyanthes Indica or cristata.)
E.
कुमुद the water lily, and मतुप् poss. affix, or वति affix of comparison, fem. ङीष्.

m. (-रुः)
The southern hemisphere or pole, the region of the demons and Titans.
E.
कु, and मेरु the mountain where the gods reside.

m. (-कः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
कु the earth, मुद to delight, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं)
Crooked-armed.

f. (-म्बा)
An enclosure round a place of sacrifice, to prevent profane intrusion.
E.
कुवि to cover, to screen or conceal, अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A small water jar.
2 The frontal globe on the upper part of the forehead of an elephant; there are two of these projections, which swell in the rutting season.
3 A sign of the zodiac, (Aquarius.)
4 A proper name, the nephew of Rāvaṇa considered as a Rākṣasa or demon.
5 The paramour of a harlot, a bully, a flash or fancy man.
6 A religious exercise, closing the nostrils and mouth, so as to suspend breathing.
7 A measure of grain equal to twenty Droṇas, a little more than three bushels and three gallons, or a Comb: some make it two Droṇas or sixty-four Seers.
n. (-भं)
1 A fragrant resin or the plant which bears it, (Bdellium.)
2 A plant commonly Teöri: see त्रिवृत्.
f. (-म्भी)
1 A pot, an earthen cooking vessel, a small jar.
2 Kāyaphal, a small tree, the seeds of which are used in medicine: see कट्फल.
3 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
4 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
(-म्भा)
A harlot, a whore.
E.
कु the earth, or base, vile, &c. उम्भ to fill, and अण् or अच् affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
Stopping the breath by shutting the mouth and closing both nostrils with the fingers of the right hand.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-णः)
The gigantic brother of RĀVAṆA.
E.
कुम्भ, and कर्ण the ear.

f. (-ला)
A bilious affection, a sort of jaundice.

m. (-रः)
1 A potter.
2 A kind of wild fowl.
f. (-री)
1 A mineral substance, used as an application to strengthen the eyes and beautify the eye lashes.
2 Red arsenic.
3 The wife of a potter.
E.
कुम्भ a jar, &c. and कार what makes, from कृ to make, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A potter.
f. (-रिका)
1 Collyrium.
2 A woman of the potter caste.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-म्बी)
A large round gourd.
E.
कुम्भ, and तुम्बी a gourd.

f. (-सी)
A bawd, a procuress.
E.
कुम्भ a bully, and दासी a female slave.

f. (-दी)
A woman with an enlarged leg.
E.
कुम्भ, and पद् for पाद a foot, fem. affix ङीष्.

m. (-दः)
A man with an enlarged leg.
E.
कुम्भ, and पाद a foot.

m. (-निः)
1 A name of AGASTYA, a saint so called.
2 Also of VAŚIṢṬHA; and,
3 Of DROṆA, the military preceptor of the Kurus and Pāṇḍus.
E.
कुम्भ a jar, and यानि a womb; born in a water jar, &c.

f. (-ला)
A plant, the flowers of which are compared to those of the Nauclea cadamba: see मुण्डिरी.

f. (-ला)
A pottery, a potter's kiln.
E.
कुम्भ a jar, and शाला a hall, a shop.

m. (-न्धिः)
The hollow on the top of an elephant's head, between the frontal globes.
E.
कुम्भ the frontal globe, and सन्धि junction.

m. (-वः)
The saint AGASTYA: see अगस्त्य.
E.
कुम्भ a jar, and सम्भव born.

m. (-ण्डः)
A minister of the Asura, BĀṆA.
mf. (-ण्डः-ण्डी)
A pumpkin gourd: see कुष्माण्ड.

f. (-का)
1 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
2 Trumpet flower.
3 A disease of the eyes, hordeolum or stye.
E.
कुम्भी as above, and कन् affix, in the fem. form.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant, the bark of which furnishes a yellow dye, (Rottleria tinctoria): see पुन्नाग.
2 An aquatic plant.
3 An affection of the eyes, hordeolum or stye: see कुम्भिका.

mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि)
1 Having a water jar.
2 Shaped like a water jar, &c.
E.
कुम्भ, and इनि affix.
m. (-म्भी)
1 An elephant.
2 A crocodile.
3 A fish.
4 A plant bearing a fragrant resin, Bdellium.
E.
कुम्भ as above, and इनि aff.

n. (-जं)
The croton nut.

m. (-दः)
The juice that exudes from an elephant's temples at certain seasons.
E.
कुम्भि, and मद the exudation.

m. (-लः)
1 A thief.
2 A plagiarist, a paraphrast.
3 A wife's brother.
4 A fish, the gilt-head.
5 A child begotten at undue seasons, or of an imperfect impregnation.
E.
कुम्भ as above, and इलच् aff.

m. (-लः)
A crocodile: see कुम्भीर.

m. (-न्यः)
Grain stored in jars sufficient, according to some, for six days, or to others for one year's consumption.
E.
कुम्भ, and धान्य grain, च्चि augment.

m. (-कः)
A householder, preserving grain in store for six days, &c.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-सः)
A large, and venomous snake.
f. (-सी)
The mother of LAVANA, a Rākṣasa or fiend.
E.
कुम्भी a pitcher, and नस derived from नासा the nose; having wide nostrils.

m. (-कः)
A hell.
E.
कुम्भी a pot, and पाक what cooks: in which the wicked are baked like potterś vessels.

m. (-रः)
The crocodile of the Ganges, the long nosed alligator.
E.
कुम्भी an elephant, and ईर what resembles; or कुम्भी a fish, and र who seizes, from रा to take or gain: or ल from ला, whence also कुम्भील.

f. (-का)
1 A sort of fly or aquatic insect.
E.
कुम्भीर a crocodile, and मक्षिका a fly, the crocodile fly, alluding, perhaps, to its size.

n. (-जं)
The nut of the croton.

n. (-मं)
A lake, a pool, a pond.
